array.string: mkdir -p "$HOME/.construct" && exec >>"$HOME/.construct/dev.mikoshi.bus.log" 2>&1 && cd "${CONSTRUCT_FACTORY_DIR:?set CONSTRUCT_FACTORY_DIR to the factory checkout with launchctl setenv}" && export PATH="$HOME/.vite-plus/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" CONSTRUCT_REVIEW_MODEL=sonnet && exec pnpm --silent bus:bg
